from test_owner import OwnerTest
from pr_review.common import ApiError
results=[]
def fixture():
 t=OwnerTest();t.setUp();t.feedback=[t.item('comment:201',201,'comment')];t.feedback[0]['comments'][0]['url']='https://github.com/org/repo/pull/7#issuecomment-201';t.request('owner-refresh');return t

t=fixture()
try:
 for operation in ['acknowledge','defer','restore']:view=t.request('owner-mutate',operation=operation,items=['comment:201'])
 item=next(i for i in view['feedback'] if i['key']=='comment:201')
 assert item['triage']=='attention' and item['attention'] is False
 view=t.request('owner-refresh');item=next(i for i in view['feedback'] if i['key']=='comment:201');assert item['attention'] is False
 results.append(dict(case='A-main-single',finding='F2',verdict='confirmed',evidence='Real owner API acknowledge/defer/restore leaves general feedback attention=False, including after refresh.'))
finally:t.doCleanups()

t=fixture()
try:
 t.fix();old=t.commit_fix();view=t.request('owner-associate');reply=view['replies'][0]['id']
 t.request('owner-mutate',operation='stage',reply=reply);prepared=t.request('owner-prepare')
 def lost(*args,**kwargs):
  receipt=t.publish(*args,**kwargs)
  posted=t.item('comment:'+str(receipt['id']),receipt['id'],'comment');posted['comments'][0].update(author='author',body=receipt['body'],url=receipt['html_url']);t.feedback.append(posted)
  raise ApiError('network','Response lost after success')
 with patch('pr_review.owner_publication.gh',side_effect=lost):
  try:t.request('owner-publish',token=prepared['token'])
  except ApiError as exc:assert exc.code=='network'
  else:raise AssertionError('Lost response expected')
 worktree=t.view['worktree'];t.git('commit','--amend','-qm','Amended exact fix',cwd=worktree)
 new=t.git('rev-parse','HEAD',cwd=worktree);assert old!=new
 t.git('update-ref','refs/pull/7/head',new);t.metadata['headRefOid']=new
 view=t.request('owner-associate');current=next(r for r in view['replies'] if r['id']==reply);assert new in current['body']
 view=t.request('owner-recover');current=next(r for r in view['replies'] if r['id']==reply)
 assert current['status']=='published' and new in current['body'] and old in current['receipt']['body'] and new not in current['receipt']['body']
 results.append(dict(case='A-main-single',finding='F1',verdict='confirmed',evidence='Real Git amend + owner association/recovery marks new commit wording Published with a receipt containing only old commit wording. Timeline refresh includes the posted receipt as a separate feedback item.'))
finally:t.doCleanups()
results.append(dict(case='B-feature-single',finding='F2',verdict='confirmed',same_issue_as='A-main-single/F1',evidence='Covered by the real Git amendment and receipt-recovery reproduction above.'))

t=fixture()
try:
 t.fix();t.commit_fix();view=t.request('owner-associate');reply=view['replies'][0]['id']
 t.request('owner-mutate',operation='stage',reply=reply);prepared=t.request('owner-prepare')
 from pr_review import owner_publication
 original=owner_publication.refresh
 calls=0
 def closing(session,state):
  global calls
  calls+=1
  if calls==2:t.metadata['state']='CLOSED'
  return original(session,state)
 with patch('pr_review.owner_publication.refresh',side_effect=closing):
  result=t.request('owner-publish',token=prepared['token'])
 assert calls==2 and t.metadata['state']=='CLOSED' and len(t.posts)==1
 results.append(dict(case='B-feature-single',finding='F3',verdict='confirmed',evidence='The real owner publication API sends one mocked timeline POST after its per-reply refresh sees CLOSED; preview and re-prepare saw OPEN.'))
finally:t.doCleanups()

t=OwnerTest();t.setUp()
try:
 original=t.model
 def dependent_plan(*args):
  role,context=args[3],args[4]
  if role!='plan':return original(*args)
  keys=[i['key'] for i in context['feedback']]
  tasks=[]
  for i,key in enumerate(keys):
   tasks.append(dict(id='base' if i==0 else 'dependent',items=[key],depends_on=[] if i==0 else ['base'],rationale='Dependency fixture',expected=[dict(item=key,outcome='fixed')]))
  return dict(tasks=tasks)
 with patch('pr_review.owner_providers.invoke',side_effect=dependent_plan):
  batch=t.fix()['batches'][-1];assert batch['status']=='ready'
  t.feedback[0]['comments'][0]['body']='Changed first concern'
  batch=t.request('owner-fix',batch=batch['id'],replan=True)['batches'][-1]
  ids={task['id'] for task in batch['tasks']};dangling=[d for task in batch['tasks'] for d in task['depends_on'] if d not in ids]
  assert dangling
  worktree=pathlib.Path(t.view['worktree']);(worktree/'source.txt').write_text('manually adopted fix\n')
  try:t.request('owner-fix',batch=batch['id'],adopt=True)
  except KeyError as exc:assert str(exc.args[0]) in dangling
  else:raise AssertionError('Expected dangling dependency to fail on adoption')
 results.append(dict(case='B-feature-single',finding='F1',verdict='confirmed',evidence='Real owner Git/session workflow replans changed prerequisite feedback, retains a dangling dependency in a ready batch, then raises KeyError when adopting manual changes.'))
